english.note: Use this when someone throws themselves face down on the ground as an act of submission or humility.

examples.english: When they see the emperor, they prostrate themselves on the ground and beg forgiveness.
examples.traditional: 佢一見到皇帝，就伏喺地下叩頭請罪。
